title: Spectral Invariant Fusion and Refinement for Domain Generalized Semantic Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2610.39926v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Domain generalized semantic segmentation is challenging because it requires accurate dense prediction on unseen domains without any access to target-domain data during training. Existing methods improve transferability through data diversification, invariant learning, or direct use of foundation models, but they often struggle to simultaneously suppress domain-sensitive interference and preserve fine-grained spatial cues. In this work, we propose SIFR, a frequency-aware dual-stream framework that tackles domain shift at both the fusion and decoding stages. SIFR uses spectral modeling as a unified principle to regulate both heterogeneous prior interaction and dense decoder refinement. Instead of directly fusing frozen CLIP and DINOv2 features, SIFR performs spectral-guided invariant fusion to filter out domain-sensitive responses while preserving complementary semantic and structural information. translated_title: 面向域泛化语义分割的频谱不变融合与精炼
translated_abstract: 域泛化语义分割具有挑战性，因为它要求在训练期间完全无法访问目标域数据的情况下，对未见过的域进行准确的密集预测。现有方法通过数据多样化、不变学习或直接使用基础模型来提升可迁移性，但它们往往难以在抑制域敏感干扰的同时保留细粒度空间线索。在本工作中，我们提出SIFR，一个频率感知的双流框架，在融合和解码两个阶段应对域偏移问题。SIFR将频谱建模作为统一原则，同时调控异构先验交互与密集解码器精炼。SIFR并非直接融合冻结的CLIP和DINOv2特征，而是执行频谱引导的不变融合，滤除域敏感响应，同时保留互补的语义与结构信息。此外，SIFR还引入了一种频谱……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出SIFR频率感知双流框架，以频谱建模为统一原则，在特征融合和解码精炼两个阶段滤除域敏感干扰并保留细粒度空间信息，从而提升域泛化语义分割性能。
en_tdlr: We propose SIFR, a frequency-aware dual-stream framework that employs spectral modeling to filter domain-sensitive interference while preserving fine-grained spatial cues at both fusion and decoding stages, improving domain generalized semantic segmentation.
